summary: Complaints centre on power cuts and transformer failures that stop water tanks, stray dog bites, and clogged drains and potholes in Amroha city, while appreciation is thin and limited to a village getting electricity after 2014, a Joya-Manauta road repair that has started, and funds sanctioned for a few roads.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row 41: Amroha, district Amroha, reservation None); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amroha_Assembly_constituency (district Amroha, reservation None)

positives.english: Work has started on the 14 km Joya to Manauta road
positives.hindi: जोया से मनौटा तक 14 किलोमीटर सड़क का काम शुरू हो गया है
positives.basis: Amroha Dehat booth list on NIC 41-Amroha includes Joya block office polling station, so Joya is listed under AC 41; Manauta not checked. Article (Amar Ujala, 8 Oct 2026): Joya crossing to Manauta, about 14 km, repair work being started after rain halted it; Executive Engineer says work has begun on the Joya-Sambhal widening; carriageway 5.5 m widened to 7 m; about Rs 19 crore; no completion date

positives.english: Darana Nagar village got electricity after 2014, now there is light
positives.hindi: दारानगर गांव में 2014 के बाद बिजली आई, अब रोशनी है
positives.basis: District-level ground report (Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026); Darana Nagar AC membership unconfirmed. Resident Mangat Singh says there was no light before 2014 and work on electricity began after that; article heading calls it a village in darkness since British times and a solar village under the Yogi government; claim is the resident's

positives.english: *First instalment has come for the Faraspura-Afzalpur road, work to start soon
positives.hindi: *फरासपुरा-अफजलपुर सड़क की पहली किस्त आ गई, काम जल्द शुरू होगा
positives.basis: Inference: funds and approval only, work not started. Amar Ujala (23 Sep 2026) explicitly names the Amroha Assembly area: Faraspura link road via Naseerpur bypass to Afzalpur road, Mukhyamantri Gramin Sadak Yojana, about 1.5 km, Rs 1.19 crore; first instalment released; work to start soon, no date

positives.english: *Rs 6 crore has come for the wards added to the municipality, drains to be built
positives.hindi: *नगर पालिका में जुड़े वार्डों के लिए छह करोड़ मिले, नालियां बनेंगी
positives.basis: Inference: Executive Officer says Rs 6 crore received for newly added wards of Amroha municipality (Amar Ujala, 5 Apr 2026); drains in waterlogged areas, roads, street lights planned. Work not started, no start date, wards not named. Weak positive pending field check

positives.english: *Roads have got better and travel has become easier, says a trader
positives.hindi: *सड़कें पहले से अच्छी हुई हैं, आना-जाना आसान हुआ है
positives.basis: Inference: one dholak trader (Deepak Agarwal, Hemlata Handicraft) in a district-level ground report (Amar Ujala, 5 Sep 2026) says state roads have improved since the Yogi government and transport is easier. The quote is about the state, names no road or stretch in Amroha and gives no date. Opinion only, weak positive

negatives.english: Transformer failed, Pirgarh mohalla without power for 36 hours, water tanks dry
negatives.hindi: ट्रांसफार्मर खराब, पीरगढ़ में 36 घंटे बिजली गुल, टंकियां भी खाली
negatives.basis: Amroha city mohalla Pirgarh; AC 41 membership of the city confirmed by exclusion (AC 40 extent lists only KCs Naugawan Sadat and Kailsa and Naugawan Sadat NP) and city booths on the NIC 41-Amroha booth list. Article (Amar Ujala, 11 Oct 2026): 400 kVA transformer at Pirgarh failed on Friday afternoon (9 Oct), about 36 hours without supply; about 250 people and about 250 families both stated; residents say empty water tanks cause a drinking water shortage; SDO says a second transformer will be installed

negatives.english: Stray dogs bit 17 people in Amroha city, eight of them children
negatives.hindi: शहर में कुत्तों ने 17 लोगों को काटा, इनमें आठ बच्चे भी शामिल
negatives.basis: Amroha city mohallas Pirzada and Mullana (both on NIC 41-Amroha booth list), Chahmullana, Jhanda Shaheed. Attacks on Saturday 10 Oct 2026 (Amar Ujala, 12 Oct 2026): 8 children and 9 others bitten; victims given anti-rabies vaccine at district hospital; residents fear a rabid dog; article reports no official response

negatives.english: When power goes the tank stops, five Amroha neighbourhoods go without water
negatives.hindi: बिजली जाते ही टंकी बंद, पांच मोहल्लों में पानी को तरसे लोग
negatives.basis: Five Amroha city mohallas: Lakshmanwali and Hussainpura Madhaiya are on NIC 41-Amroha booth list; Mehmadi Sarai, Chunni Wali Madhaiya, Imli Wali Madhaiya city mohallas. Amar Ujala, 3 Oct 2026: tanks run on electricity so supply stops during cuts; residents petitioned municipal chairman for solar lights and a generator; EO Dinesh Kumar says a generator-based supply will be arranged

negatives.english: Drains full of filth in Amroha city, cleaning is only a formality
negatives.hindi: नाले गंदगी से भरे, सफाई के नाम पर खानापूर्ति
negatives.basis: Amroha city; Katkui, Nai Basti, Bijnor Road, Joya Road and Kailsa Road (Amroha city stretch) are on NIC 41-Amroha booth list; Chhebra, Beriyan, Atrasi Road, Mangalvar Bazar and Gandhi Murti crossing are city places, confirmed by city membership. Amar Ujala, 5 May 2026: drains clogged with waste, polythene and dirt; cleaning called token and only half done by residents; municipality's lakh-rupee cleaning claims submerged in light rain; article has no official response

negatives.english: Potholes and standing water on Subodh Nagar road, bikers fall and get hurt
negatives.hindi: सुबोध नगर मार्ग पर गड्ढे और भरा पानी, बाइक सवार गिरकर घायल
negatives.basis: Subodh Nagar and Pushkar Nagar link road, Amroha dateline. Amar Ujala, 31 May 2026: potholes and standing water on the main road for a long time, water always pooled near a primary school, several bikers fallen and injured; residents say municipal and PWD officials have not acted. AC 41 membership of Subodh Nagar not confirmed (not on NIC booth list); article reports no official response

notes: AC confirmed as No. 41 Amroha, district Amroha, reservation None (Wikipedia list row 41 and AC page). AC 41 extent text is still not retrieved: the English AC page has no extent section; retried this round, no tehsil/KC/ward detail. Membership of Amroha city is inferred by exclusion from the AC 40 extent (Wikipedia Naugawan Sadat page: tehsil Amroha KCs Naugawan Sadat, Kailsa and Naugawan Sadat NP; city not listed) and confirmed by the NIC 41-Amroha polling-station list, which includes many city mohallas (Pirzada, Mullana, Madhaiya Lakshmanwali and Hussainpura, Katkui, Bijnor Road, Joya Road, Nal Nayi Basti, Kailsa Road block campus) and Joya block. This is a strong but indirect confirmation. Pirgarh, Chhebra, Subodh Nagar are not on the booth list. Subodh Nagar is not counted. Excluded earlier: Kalali Road (Dhanaura side), Nawada and Pushkarnagar items (ward membership unconfirmed), Gajraula, Hasanpur, Dhanaura items. Transformer article gives 250 people and 250 families, unreconciled. Sugarcane dues: no Amroha-specific report found. Positive 3 names the Amroha Assembly area but is only an approval, so inference. Positives 4 and 5 are weak inferences. Searches for completed local projects (roads, drains, CHC) in Amroha city found only plans and tenders, not completion reports. Field check recommended: confirm AC 41 extent from the UP delimitation order or district NIC site; whether Pirgarh, Subodh Nagar, Darana Nagar and Manauta are inside AC 41; and whether Faraspura-Afzalpur work has started.

Negatives 1-4 now AC-specific (4); negative 5 unconfirmed. Negative 1 English/basis corrected (no storm claim); negative 4 'rain floods roads' claim removed (not in article); negative 5 basis corrected (Bambugarh and Kailsa not in article). Positive 1 basis adds Joya block booth listing. Positive 5 basis states it is a state-level quote. Positive 1-5 re-ranked: unchanged. No completed local project found in searches, so 3 inference items remain (positives 3, 4, 5).
